bugs.reason: A known tar extraction stream bug on Node 17 and newer prevents fetching; the same immutable lockfile and frozen control pass under Node 16.11.1.
bugs.semanticEvidence: Official yarnpkg/berry#3610 replaces PassThrough.destroy() with end() after tar close and explicitly fixes Node 17 ERR_STREAM_PREMATURE_CLOSE. Both exact affected releases 3.1.0-rc.11 and 3.1.0-rc.12 were independently executed with the unchanged current yarn-modern-v5 fixture on Node 16.11.1, installing is-number 7.0.0 with no root lock or manifest byte changes and rejecting the contradictory is-number 6.0.0 control. Reproductions and original observation fingerprints are archived under maintenance/evidence/gap-audit/yarn. This review is deliberately restricted to v5 rc.11/rc.12: v4 observations affected by the same stream bug also have an independently reproduced cache generation migration, so they are not excused.
